title.ur: Islam ko sahi tareeqe se kaise samjhein?

intro.en: Jonas asks his classmate Ibrahim questions about Islam. Ibrahim answers kindly and advises him to read fair books. Notice the phrase «يُسْعِدُني ذلِك» – 'that makes me happy'.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Yonas apne hum-jamaat Ibrahim se Islam ke bare mein sawal poochta hai. Ibrahim narmi se jawab deta hai aur munsif kitaben parhne ka mashwara deta hai. «يُسْعِدُني ذلِك» yaani 'mujhe is se khushi hoti hai'.
intro.ar: يَسْأَلُ يوناسُ زَميلَهُ إِبْراهيمَ أَسْئِلَةً عَنِ الإِسْلامِ، فَيُجيبُهُ إِبْراهيمُ بِلُطْفٍ وَيَنْصَحُهُ بِقِراءَةِ كُتُبٍ مُنْصِفَةٍ. لاحِظْ عِبارَةَ «يُسْعِدُني ذلِك».

dialogue.ar: عِنْدي أَسْئِلَةٌ كَثيرَةٌ عَنِ الإِسْلامِ، فَهَلْ تَسْمَحُ لي بِها يا إِبْراهيم؟
dialogue.tr: ʿindī asʾilatun kathīratun ʿani l-islām, fahal tasmaḥu lī bihā yā ibrāhīm?
dialogue.en: I have many questions about Islam; will you let me ask them, Ibrahim?
dialogue.ur: Mere paas Islam ke bare mein bohat se sawal hain; kya aap mujhe poochne ki ijazat denge, Ibrahim?

dialogue.ar: يُسْعِدُني ذلِكَ يا يوناس، وَأُرَحِّبُ بِكُلِّ سُؤال. تَفَضَّلْ.
dialogue.tr: yusʿidunī dhālik yā yūnās, waʾuraḥḥibu bikulli suʾāl. tafaḍḍal.
dialogue.en: That makes me happy, Jonas, and I welcome every question. Go ahead.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe khushi hogi Yonas, aur main har sawal ka khair-maqdam karta hoon. Tafaddal farmayein.

dialogue.ar: سَمِعْتُ أَنَّ نَبِيَّكُمْ مُحَمَّداً ﷺ كانَ أُمِّيّاً. هَلْ هذا صَحيح؟
dialogue.tr: samiʿtu anna nabiyyakum muḥammadan ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam kāna ummiyyan. hal hādhā ṣaḥīḥ?
dialogue.en: I heard that your Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was unlettered. Is that true?
dialogue.ur: Maine suna hai ke aap ke Nabi Muhammad ﷺ ummi the. Kya yeh durust hai?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، كانَ أُمِّيّاً لا يَقْرَأُ وَلا يَكْتُب، وَهذا مَعْروفٌ عِنْدَنا.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, kāna ummiyyan lā yaqraʾu walā yaktub, wahdhā maʿrūfun ʿindanā.
dialogue.en: Yes, he was unlettered; he could neither read nor write, and this is well known among us.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, woh ummi the; na parhte the na likhte the, aur yeh hamare haan mashhoor hai.

dialogue.ar: وَكَيْفَ جاءَ بِحَقائِقَ لَمْ يَعْرِفْها قَوْمُهُ، وَأَكَّدَها العُلَماءُ في عَصْرِنا؟
dialogue.tr: wakayfa jāʾa biḥaqāʾiqa lam yaʿrifhā qawmuh, waʾakkadahā l-ʿulamāʾu fī ʿaṣrinā?
dialogue.en: Then how did he bring facts that his people did not know, and which scholars have confirmed in our age?
dialogue.ur: Phir woh aisi haqeeqatein kaise laye jo unki qaum nahin jaanti thi, aur hamare zamane mein ulama ne unki tasdeeq ki?

dialogue.ar: لَمْ يَصِلْ إِلَيْها بِنَفْسِهِ، فَهِيَ وَحْيٌ مِنَ اللهِ. وَهذا دَليلٌ عَلى صِدْقِ رِسالَتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: lam yaṣil ilayhā binafsih, fahiya waḥyun mina llāh. wahdhā dalīlun ʿalā ṣidqi risālatih.
dialogue.en: He did not reach them by himself; they are revelation from Allah. And this is proof of the truth of his message.
dialogue.ur: Woh khud in tak nahin pahunche, yeh Allah ki taraf se wahi hai. Aur yeh unki risalat ki sachai ki daleel hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهَلْ يَخْتَصُّ الإِسْلامُ بِالعَرَبِ دونَ غَيْرِهِمْ؟
dialogue.tr: wahal yakhtaṣṣu l-islāmu bilʿarabi dūna ghayrihim?
dialogue.en: And is Islam only for the Arabs and not for others?
dialogue.ur: Aur kya Islam sirf Arabon ke liye hai, doosron ke liye nahin?

dialogue.ar: لا، فَهُوَ لِلنّاسِ كُلِّهِمْ. المُسْلِمونَ شُعوبٌ كَثيرَةٌ، لَهُمْ لُغاتٌ وَأَعْراقٌ وَأَلْوانٌ مُخْتَلِفَة.
dialogue.tr: lā, fahuwa lilnnāsi kullihim. al-muslimūna shuʿūbun kathīrah, lahum lughātun waʾaʿrāqun waʾalwānun mukhtalifah.
dialogue.en: No, it is for all people. Muslims are many peoples, with different languages, races and colours.
dialogue.ur: Nahin, yeh tamam logon ke liye hai. Musalman bohat si qaumein hain, jin ki zabanein, nasalein aur rang mukhtalif hain.

dialogue.ar: أَنا أَجِدُ صُعوبَةً في فَهْمِ الإِسْلامِ؛ فَمَعْلوماتي كُلُّها مِنْ أَفْلامٍ وَمَقالات.
dialogue.tr: anā ajidu ṣuʿūbatan fī fahmi l-islām; famaʿlūmātī kulluhā min aflāmin wamaqālāt.
dialogue.en: I find it hard to understand Islam; all my information comes from films and articles.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe Islam samajhne mein mushkil hoti hai; meri saari maloomat filmon aur mazameen se hai.

dialogue.ar: لِأَنَّكَ تَعْتَمِدُ عَلى مَصادِرَ مُعادِيَةٍ لِلإِسْلامِ. اِبْحَثْ عَنْ كُتُبٍ مُحايِدَةٍ، أَوْ عَنْ كُتُبٍ كَتَبَها مُسْلِمونَ صادِقون.
dialogue.tr: liʾannaka taʿtamidu ʿalā maṣādira muʿādiyatin lilʾislām. ibḥath ʿan kutubin muḥāyidah, aw ʿan kutubin katabahā muslimūna ṣādiqūn.
dialogue.en: Because you rely on sources that are hostile to Islam. Look for neutral books, or books written by honest Muslims.
dialogue.ur: Kyunke aap Islam ke mukhalif zara'i par bharosa karte hain. Ghair-jaanibdaar kitaben talash karein, ya aisi kitaben jo sacche Musalmanon ne likhi hon.

dialogue.ar: سَأَبْدَأُ بِذلِكَ مِنْ هذا الأُسْبوع.
dialogue.tr: saʾabdaʾu bidhlika min hādhā l-usbūʿ.
dialogue.en: I will start with that this week.
dialogue.ur: Main isi hafte se is ki shuruaat karunga.

dialogue.ar: وَسَتَعْلَمُ الكَثير، إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ. وَسَأُعيرُكَ كِتاباً جَميلاً.
dialogue.tr: wasataʿlamu l-kathīr, in shāʾa llāh. wasaʾuʿīruka kitāban jamīlan.
dialogue.en: And you will learn a lot, God willing. I will lend you a lovely book.
dialogue.ur: Aur aap bohat kuch jaan jayenge, insha'Allah. Main aap ko ek umda kitab udhaar dunga.

q.ur: Yonas ne Ibrahim se kya poocha ...

options_ar: أَنْ يُجيبَهُ عَنْ أَسْئِلَتِهِ حَوْلَ الإِسْلامِ

q.ar: ما مَعْنى وَصْفِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِأَنَّهُ «أُمِّيّ»؟

options: Yes, he did not read or write

q.en: Ibrahim says Islam is the religion of ...
q.ur: Ibrahim kehta hai ke Islam kis ka deen hai ...

intro.en: Arabic does not allow two sukuns (silent letters) together except when you stop. Fix it by dropping the first or giving it a vowel. Example: «يَقُولُ» becomes «لَمْ يَقُلْ».
intro.ur: Arabi mein do saakin harf ek saath nahin aate, sirf waqf (rukne) ke waqt. Isay pehla harf hazf karke ya harkat dekar theek karte hain. Misaal: «يَقُولُ» se «لَمْ يَقُلْ».
intro.ar: لا تَسْمَحُ العَرَبِيَّةُ بِالْتِقاءِ ساكِنَيْنِ إِلّا عِنْدَ الوَقْفِ. وَنُعالِجُ ذلِكَ بِحَذْفِ الأَوَّلِ أَوْ بِتَحْريكِهِ. مِثالٌ: «يَقُولُ» تُصْبِحُ «لَمْ يَقُلْ».

vocab.ur: woh chalata hai / rehnumai karta hai

q.en: In Arabic two sukuns can meet only ...
q.ur: Arabi mein do saakin sirf kab milte hain ...
q.ar: مَتى يَجوزُ التِقاءُ ساكِنَيْنِ في العَرَبِيَّةِ؟

options: at the start of a word
options_ar: لا يَجوزُ أَبَداً حَتّى في الوَقْفِ

q.en: How do we remove the meeting of two sukuns?
q.ur: Do saakin ke milne ko kaise door karte hain?

options: drop or vowel the first one

intro.en: Arabic letters are of two kinds. The weak letters are only three: ا و ي. All the other letters are sound. Example: the verb «قالَ» has a weak letter in the middle, «بابٌ» has only sound letters.
intro.ur: Arabi huroof ki do qismein hain. Mo'tall (kamzor) huroof sirf teen hain: ا و ي. Baqi sab huroof sahih hain. Misaal: «قالَ» ke beech mein harf-e-illat hai, jabke «بابٌ» mein sirf sahih huroof hain.
intro.ar: الحُروفُ العَرَبِيَّةُ نَوْعانِ: حُروفُ العِلَّةِ وَهِيَ ثَلاثَةٌ فَقَطْ (ا و ي)، وَالحُروفُ الصَّحيحَةُ وَهِيَ البَاقِيَةُ. في «قالَ» حَرْفُ عِلَّةٍ في الوَسَطِ، وَفي «بابٌ» حُروفٌ صَحيحَةٌ فَقَطْ.

q.en: How many weak letters are there?
Which letters are called sound letters?
q.ur: Sahih huroof kaun se kehlate hain?

options: all letters except ا و ي
options_ar: كُلُّ الحُروفِ ما عَدا ا و ي

q.en: Which word has a weak letter in it?

intro.en: Listen to the dialogue between Sara and Tariq on the audio and answer the questions. Then practise asking a classmate about Islam: Do you know Islam well? Have you memorised the Quran?
intro.ur: Audio mein Sara aur Tariq ka mukalma suniye aur sawalon ke jawab dijiye. Phir apne saathi se Islam ke bare mein poochein: Kya aap Islam ko achhi tarah jaante hain? Kya aapne Quran yaad kiya hai?
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى الحِوارِ بَيْنَ سارَة وَطارِق وَأَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ. ثُمَّ تَدَرَّبْ مَعَ زَميلِكَ عَلى سُؤالٍ عَنِ الإِسْلامِ، مِثْلَ: هَلْ تَعْرِفُ الإِسْلامَ جَيِّداً؟ هَلْ حَفِظْتَ القُرْآنَ؟

intro.en: A reading passage: Islam is the religion of tawheed brought by all the messengers. The passage uses verses and a hadith. Read slowly, sentence by sentence.
intro.ur: Ek parhne ka matn: Islam tawheed ka deen hai jo tamam rasoolon ko diya gaya. Matn mein ayaat aur ek hadees hai. Aahista aahista, jumla ba jumla parhein.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ: الإِسْلامُ دينُ التَّوْحيدِ الَّذي جاءَ بِهِ جَميعُ الرُّسُلِ. في النَّصِّ آياتٌ وَحَديثٌ. اِقْرَأْ ببُطْءٍ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَةً.

dialogue.ar: الإِسْلامُ هُوَ دينُ التَّوْحيدِ الَّذي دَعا إِلَيْهِ كُلُّ الأَنْبِياءِ وَالرُّسُلِ، وَقَدْ كانَ نوحٌ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَوَّلَهُمْ، وَمُحَمَّدٌ ﷺ آخِرَهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: al-islāmu huwa dīnu t-tawḥīdi illadhī daʿā ilayhi kullu l-anbīʾi wālrrusul, waqad kāna nūḥun ʿalayhi s-salāmu awwalahum, wamuḥammadun ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam ʾākhirahum.
dialogue.en: Islam is the religion of tawheed to which all the prophets and messengers called; Nuh, peace be upon him, was the first of them, and Muhammad ﷺ the last.
dialogue.ur: Islam tauheed ka deen hai jis ki taraf tamam anbiya aur rusul ne bulaya; Nuh alaihissalam un mein pehle the, aur Muhammad ﷺ aakhri.

dialogue.ar: قالَ تَعالى: ﴿إِنَّ الدِّينَ عِندَ اللَّهِ الْإِسْلَامُ﴾.
dialogue.tr: qāla taʿālā: inna d-dīna ʿinda llāhi l-islām
dialogue.en: Allah the Most High said: Indeed, the religion with Allah is Islam.
dialogue.ur: Allah Taala ne farmaya: Beshak Allah ke nazdeek deen Islam hi hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهُوَ رِسالَةٌ لِلبَشَرِ جَميعاً، تَصْلُحُ لِكُلِّ زَمانٍ وَمَكان، وَقَدْ تَكَفَّلَ اللهُ بِحِفْظِ كِتابِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wahuwa risālatun lilbashari jamīʿan, taṣluḥu likulli zamānin wamakān, waqad takaffala llāh biḥifẓi kitābih.
dialogue.en: It is a message for all mankind, suitable for every time and place, and Allah has taken charge of preserving His Book.
dialogue.ur: Yeh tamam insanon ke liye paigham hai, har zamane aur har jagah ke liye munasib, aur Allah ne apni kitab ki hifazat ka zimma liya hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالمُسْلِمُ يُؤْمِنُ بِالأَنْبِياءِ كُلِّهِمْ، وَلا يُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: wālmuslimu yuʾminu bilʾanbīʾi kullihim, walā yufarriqu bayna aḥadin minhum.
dialogue.en: A Muslim believes in all the prophets and makes no distinction between any of them.
dialogue.ur: Musalman tamam anbiya par iman rakhta hai aur un mein se kisi ke darmiyan farq nahin karta.

dialogue.ar: وَيُحارِبُ الإِسْلامُ الظُّلْمَ بَيْنَ النّاسِ، وَيَدْعو إِلَى العَدْلِ وَالإِخاء.
dialogue.tr: wayuḥāribu l-islāmu ẓ-ẓulma bayna n-nās, wayadʿū ilā l-ʿadli wālʾikhāʾ.
dialogue.en: Islam fights injustice among people and calls to justice and brotherhood.
dialogue.ur: Islam logon ke darmiyan zulm ka muqabla karta hai aur insaf aur bhai-chare ki dawat deta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلِهذا دَخَلَتْ فيهِ شُعوبٌ كَثيرَةٌ عَنْ رَغْبَةٍ لا عَنْ رَهْبَةٍ، لِأَنَّها وَجَدَتْ فيهِ المُساواةَ.
dialogue.tr: walihdhā dakhalat fīhi shuʿūbun kathīratun ʿan raghbatin lā ʿan rahbah, liʾannahā wajadat fīhi l-musāwāh.
dialogue.en: That is why many peoples entered it out of desire, not fear, because they found equality in it.
dialogue.ur: Isi liye bohat si qaumein is mein rghbat se dakhil huin, khauf se nahin, kyunke unhon ne is mein musawat paayi.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: (كُلُّكُمْ لِآدَمَ وَآدَمُ مِنْ تُراب. لا فَضْلَ لِعَرَبِيٍّ عَلى أَعْجَمِيٍّ، وَلا لِأَسْوَدَ عَلى أَحْمَرَ إِلّا بِالتَّقْوى).
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūlu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam: kulluku li-Ādam, wa-Ādamu min turāb. lā faḍla li-ʿarabiyyin ʿalā aʿjamiyy, wa-lā li-aswada ʿalā aḥmara illā bit-taqwā
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ said: All of you are from Adam, and Adam is from dust. An Arab has no superiority over a non-Arab, nor a black over a red, except by taqwa.
dialogue.ur: Rasool ﷺ ne farmaya: Tum sab Adam se ho aur Adam mitti se hain. Kisi Arab ko ajmi par aur kisi kaale ko surkh par fazilat nahin, magar taqwa se.

q.en: Who was the first of the messengers, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq pehle rasool kaun the?

q.en: Why did peoples accept Islam, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq qaumon ne Islam kyun qubool kiya?
q.ar: لِماذا قَبِلَتِ الشُّعوبُ الإِسْلامَ حَسَبَ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: «لا فَضْلَ لِعَرَبِيٍّ عَلى أَعْجَمِيٍّ إِلّا بِالتَّقْوى» means ...
q.ar: ما مَعْنى «لا فَضْلَ لِعَرَبِيٍّ عَلى أَعْجَمِيٍّ إِلّا بِالتَّقْوى»؟

intro.en: A broken plural is a plural where the word's shape changes, like طِفْلٌ → أَطْفالٌ. It is used for people with reason and without, men or women. There is no fixed rule, so learn the patterns.
intro.ur: Jam'-e-taksir woh jama hai jis mein lafz ki shakl badal jaati hai, jaise طِفْلٌ se أَطْفالٌ. Yeh aaqil aur ghair-aaqil, mozakkar aur moannas dono ke liye aata hai. Iska koi pakka qaida nahin, wazan yaad karein.
intro.ar: جَمْعُ التَّكْسيرِ جَمْعٌ يَتَغَيَّرُ فيهِ شَكْلُ المُفْرَدِ، مِثْلَ طِفْلٌ ← أَطْفالٌ. يُسْتَعْمَلُ لِلعاقِلِ وَغَيْرِ العاقِلِ، لِلمُذَكَّرِ وَالمُؤَنَّثِ، وَلَيْسَ لَهُ قاعِدَةٌ ثابِتَةٌ فَاحْفَظْ أَوْزانَهُ.

title.ur: Marcus ne Islam kyun qubool kiya?

intro.en: Henry and Richard see their colleague Marcus coming out of the mosque. He tells them he became Muslim and gives his reasons: the Quran's description of the foetus and Islamic values such as truth, trust, justice and peace.
intro.ur: Henry aur Richard apne saathi Marcus ko masjid se nikalte dekhte hain. Woh batata hai ke us ne Islam qubool kar liya aur wajuhaat bayan karta hai: Quran ka janeen ka bayan aur Islam ki iqdaar jaise sachai, amanat, insaf aur salamti.
intro.ar: يَرى هِنْري وَريتشارْد زَميلَهُما ماركوس يَخْرُجُ مِنَ المَسْجِدِ، فَيُخْبِرُهُما أَنَّهُ أَسْلَمَ، وَيَذْكُرُ أَسْبابَهُ: وَصْفُ القُرْآنِ لِلجَنينِ وَقِيَمُ الإِسْلامِ كَالصِّدْقِ وَالأَمانَةِ وَالعَدْلِ وَالسَّلامِ.

dialogue.ar: رَأَيْتُ ماركوس يَخْرُجُ مِنَ المَسْجِدِ هذا الصَّباح! ما الخَبَر؟
dialogue.tr: raʾaytu mārkūs yakhruju mina l-masjidi hādhā ṣ-ṣabāḥ! mā l-khabar?
dialogue.en: I saw Marcus coming out of the mosque this morning! What is the news?
dialogue.ur: Maine aaj subah Marcus ko masjid se nikalte dekha! Kya baat hai?

dialogue.ar: أَسْلَمَ ماركوس قَبْلَ شَهْرَيْنِ، وَيُصَلّي بِانْتِظامٍ في مَسْجِدِ حَيِّنا.
dialogue.tr: aslama mārkūs qabla shahrayn, wayuṣallī bintiẓāmin fī masjidi ḥayyinā.
dialogue.en: Marcus became Muslim two months ago, and he prays in the mosque regularly.
dialogue.ur: Marcus do mahine pehle Musalman hua, aur woh masjid mein baqaidgi se namaz parhta hai.

dialogue.ar: أَصَحيحٌ أَنَّكَ أَسْلَمْتَ يا ماركوس؟
dialogue.tr: aṣaḥīḥun annaka aslamta yā mārkūs?
dialogue.en: Is it true that you became Muslim, Marcus?
dialogue.ur: Kya yeh sach hai ke aap Musalman ho gaye, Marcus?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، لَقَدْ أَسْلَمْتُ مُنْذُ شَهْرَيْنِ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلّهِ عَلى ذلِك.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, laqad aslamtu mundhu shahrayn, wālḥamdu lillhi ʿalā dhālik.
dialogue.en: Yes, I became Muslim two months ago, and praise be to Allah for that.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, main do mahine pehle Musalman hua, aur is par Allah ka shukr hai.

dialogue.ar: وَما الَّذي دَفَعَكَ إِلى ذلِك؟
dialogue.tr: wamā illadhī dafaʿaka ilā dhālik?
dialogue.en: And what drove you to that?
dialogue.ur: Aur aap ko is par kis cheez ne aamada kiya?

dialogue.ar: أَسْبابٌ عَديدَة؛ أَوَّلُها وَصْفُ القُرْآنِ لِمَراحِلِ نُمُوِّ الجَنينِ في بَطْنِ الأُمّ. وَأَنا طَبيبُ أَطْفال، فَأَعْرِفُ دِقَّةَ هذا الوَصْف، وَقَدْ نَزَلَ القُرْآنُ قَبْلَ قُرونٍ طَويلَة.
dialogue.tr: asbābun ʿadīdah; awwaluhā waṣfu l-qurʾāni limarāḥili numuwwi l-janīni fī baṭni l-umm. waʾanā ṭabību aṭfāl, faʾaʿrifu diqqata hādhā l-waṣf, waqad nazala l-qurʾānu qabla qurūnin ṭawīlah.
dialogue.en: Many reasons; the first is the Quran's description of the stages of the foetus's growth in the mother's womb. I am a children's doctor, so I know how accurate this description is, and the Quran came down many centuries ago.
dialogue.ur: Bohat si wajuhaat; pehli yeh ke Quran ne maa ke pet mein janeen ke nashonuma ke marahil bayan kiye. Main bachon ka doctor hoon, is liye is bayan ki durustgi jaanta hoon, aur Quran kai sadiyon pehle nazil hua.

dialogue.ar: وَهَلْ عِنْدَكَ أَسْبابٌ غَيْرُ هذا؟
dialogue.tr: wahal ʿindaka asbābun ghayru hādhā?
dialogue.en: And do you have reasons other than this?
dialogue.ur: Aur kya aap ke paas is ke ilawa bhi wajuhaat hain?

dialogue.ar: طَبْعاً، فَقَدْ وَجَدْتُ في الإِسْلامِ الأَمانَةَ وَالصِّدْقَ وَالعَدْلَ وَالسَّلام، وَوَجَدْتُهُ يَدْعو إِلى عِبادَةِ اللهِ وَحْدَهُ. وَقَرَأْتُ دِراساتٍ كَثيرَةً قَبْلَ قَراري.
dialogue.tr: ṭabʿan, faqad wajadtu fī l-islāmi l-amānata wālṣṣidqa wālʿadla wālssalām, wawajadtuhu yadʿū ilā ʿibādati llāh waḥdah. waqaraʾtu dirāsātin kathīratan qabla qarārī.
dialogue.en: Of course; I found trust, truthfulness, justice and peace in Islam, and I found that it calls to worship Allah alone. I also read many studies before my decision.
dialogue.ur: Zaroor; maine Islam mein amanat, sachai, insaf aur salamti paayi, aur dekha ke yeh sirf Allah ki ibadat ki dawat deta hai. Faisle se pehle maine bohat si tehqeeqat bhi parhin.

dialogue.ar: أُريدُ أَنْ أَقْرَأَ عَنْهُ أَيْضاً؛ أَعِرْني ما عِنْدَكَ مِنْ كُتُبٍ وَدِراسات.
dialogue.tr: urīdu an aqraʾa ʿanhu ayḍan; aʿirnī mā ʿindaka min kutubin wadirāsāt.
dialogue.en: I want to read about it too; lend me whatever books and studies you have.
dialogue.ur: Main bhi is ke bare mein parhna chahta hoon; jo kitaben aur tehqeeqat aap ke paas hain mujhe udhaar dein.

dialogue.ar: يَسُرُّني ذلِكَ، فَفي مَكْتَبَتي رُفوفٌ مِنَ الكُتُبِ حَوْلَ الإِسْلام.
dialogue.tr: yasurrunī dhālik, fafī maktabatī rufūfun mina l-kutubi ḥawla l-islām.
dialogue.en: Gladly; my library is full of books about Islam.
dialogue.ur: Khushi se; meri library Islam ki kitabon se bhari hui hai.

dialogue.ar: اِشْرَبا مَعي القَهْوَةَ في البَيْتِ، وَسَأُعْطيكُما بَعْضَ الكُتُبِ هُناك.
dialogue.tr: ishrabā maʿī l-qahwata fī l-bayt, wasaʾuʿṭīkumā baʿḍa l-kutubi hunāk.
dialogue.en: Drink coffee with me at home, and I will give you some books there.
dialogue.ur: Mere saath ghar par coffee piyein, aur main wahan aap dono ko kuch kitaben dunga.

dialogue.ar: فِكْرَةٌ جَميلَة، لِنَذْهَبْ.
dialogue.tr: fikratun jamīlah, linadhhab.
dialogue.en: A lovely idea; let us go.
dialogue.ur: Bahut acha khayal hai; chalein.

options: Marcus coming out of the mosque

q.en: What does the Quran describe, which Marcus knows as a doctor?
q.ur: Quran kis cheez ka bayan karta hai jo Marcus doctor hone ki wajah se jaanta hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَصِفُ القُرْآنُ مِمّا يَعْرِفُهُ ماركوس لِأَنَّهُ طَبيبٌ؟

options: the foetus in the mother's womb

q.ur: Marcus «أَسْلَمْتُ» ke saath kya kehta hai?

title.en: Case endings of the sound feminine plural

intro.en: The sound feminine plural ends in ـات. Rule: it takes damma when it is the subject, and kasra for both accusative and genitive. Example: الطّالِباتُ ناجِحاتٌ (damma), فَحَصَتِ الطَّبيبَةُ المَريضاتِ (kasra).
intro.ur: Jam'-e-mo'annas saalim ـات par khatam hota hai. Qaida: marfu' ho to zamma, aur mansub aur majroor dono mein kasra. Misaal: الطّالِباتُ ناجِحاتٌ (zamma), فَحَصَتِ الطَّبيبَةُ المَريضاتِ (kasra).
intro.ar: جَمْعُ المُؤَنَّثِ السّالِمُ يَنْتَهي بِـ ـات. يُرْفَعُ بِالضَّمَّةِ، وَيُنْصَبُ وَيُجَرُّ بِالكَسْرَةِ. مِثالٌ: الطّالِباتُ ناجِحاتٌ (ضَمَّةٌ)، فَحَصَتِ الطَّبيبَةُ المَريضاتِ (كَسْرَةٌ).

q.en: The sound feminine plural in the nominative takes ...
q.ar: جَمْعُ المُؤَنَّثِ السّالِمُ في حالَةِ الرَّفْعِ عَلامَتُهُ...

q.en: In «فَحَصَتِ الطَّبيبَةُ المَريضاتِ» the word «المَريضاتِ» ends with ...
q.ar: في «فَحَصَتِ الطَّبيبَةُ المَريضاتِ» عَلامَةُ نَصْبِ «المَريضاتِ» هِيَ...

q.en: Which word is a sound feminine plural?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz jam'-e-mo'annas saalim hai?

intro.en: Listen to the text and choose the right answer. Then practise speaking: invite someone to Islam, ask for a book, and talk about the future of Islam. Use polite phrases like «أُريدُ أَنْ…».
intro.ur: Matn suniye aur sahi jawab chuniye. Phir bolne ki mashq: kisi ko Islam ki dawat dena, kitab maangna aur Islam ke mustaqbil par baat karna. «أُريدُ أَنْ…» jaise jumle istemal karein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى النَّصِّ وَاخْتَرِ الإِجابَةَ الصَّحيحَةَ. ثُمَّ تَدَرَّبْ عَلى الكَلامِ: ادْعُ شَخْصاً إِلى الإِسْلامِ، وَاطْلُبْ كِتاباً، وَتَحَدَّثْ عَنْ مُسْتَقْبَلِ الإِسْلامِ. اِسْتَعْمِلْ عِباراتٍ مُهَذَّبَةً مِثْلَ «أُريدُ أَنْ…».

options: I invite a person to Islam
I sell a person a book
options_ar: أَطْلُبُ مِنْهُ أَنْ يَعْرِفَ الإِسْلامَ وَيَدْخُلَ فيهِ

intro.en: A reading passage about the five pillars: the two testimonies, prayer, zakah, fasting and Hajj. Notice the hadith that begins «بُنِيَ الإِسْلامُ عَلى خَمْس».
intro.ur: Islam ke paanch arkan ka matn: shahadatain, namaz, zakat, roza aur hajj. Woh hadees dekhein jo «بُنِيَ الإِسْلامُ عَلى خَمْس» se shuru hoti hai.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ عَنْ أَرْكانِ الإِسْلامِ الخَمْسَةِ: الشَّهادَتانِ وَالصَّلاةُ وَالزَّكاةُ وَالصَّوْمُ وَالحَجُّ. لاحِظِ الحَديثَ الَّذي يَبْدَأُ بِـ «بُنِيَ الإِسْلامُ عَلى خَمْس».

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: (بُنِيَ الإِسْلامُ عَلى خَمْس: شَهادَةِ أَنْ لا إِلهَ إِلّا اللهُ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً رَسولُ اللهِ، وَإِقامِ الصَّلاةِ، وَإيتاءِ الزَّكاةِ، وَحَجِّ البَيْتِ، وَصَوْمِ رَمَضان).
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūlu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam: buniya l-islāmu ʿalā khams: shahādati an lā ilāha illā llāh, wa-anna Muḥammadan rasūlu llāh, wa-iqāmi ṣ-ṣalāh, wa-ītāʾi z-zakāh, wa-ḥajji l-bayt, wa-ṣawmi Ramaḍān
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ said: Islam is built on five: testifying that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, establishing prayer, giving zakah, Hajj to the House, and fasting Ramadan.
dialogue.ur: Rasool ﷺ ne farmaya: Islam ki bunyad paanch cheezon par hai: gawahi dena ke Allah ke siwa koi ilah nahin aur Muhammad Allah ke rasool hain, namaz qayam karna, zakat dena, baitullah ka hajj aur Ramadan ke roze.

dialogue.ar: أَوَّلُ هذِهِ الأَرْكانِ الشَّهادَتانِ، وَبِهِما يَدْخُلُ الإِنْسانُ في الإِسْلام.
dialogue.tr: awwalu hādhihi l-arkāni sh-shahādatān, wabihimā yadkhulu l-insānu fī l-islām.
dialogue.en: The first of these pillars is the two testimonies, and by them a person enters Islam.
dialogue.ur: In arkan mein pehla rukn shahadatain hain, aur inhi se insan Islam mein dakhil hota hai.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ تَأْتي الصَّلاةُ، وَهِيَ عَمودُ الدّينِ، وَسَيُسْأَلُ العَبْدُ عَنْها في يَوْمِ القِيامَة.
dialogue.tr: thumma taʾtī ṣ-ṣalāh, wahiya ʿamūdu d-dīn, wasayusʾalu l-ʿabdu ʿanhā fī yawmi l-qīmah.
dialogue.en: The second is prayer, the pillar of the religion. Allah will ask His servants about it on the Day of Resurrection.
dialogue.ur: Doosra namaz hai, jo deen ka sutoon hai. Allah qayamat ke din bandon se is ke bare mein poochega.

dialogue.ar: يُصَلّي المُسْلِمُ خَمْسَ صَلَواتٍ في اليَوْم: الفَجْرَ ثُمَّ الظُّهْرَ ثُمَّ العَصْرَ ثُمَّ المَغْرِبَ ثُمَّ العِشاء، وَلِكُلِّ صَلاةٍ وَقْتٌ مَعْلوم.
dialogue.tr: yuṣallī l-muslimu khamsa ṣalawātin fī l-yawm: al-fajra thumma ẓ-ẓuhra thumma l-ʿaṣra thumma l-maghriba thumma l-ʿishāʾ, walikulli ṣalātin waqtun maʿlūm.
dialogue.en: A Muslim prays five prayers a day: Fajr, then Dhuhr, then Asr, then Maghrib, then Isha, and each prayer has a known time.
dialogue.ur: Musalman din mein paanch namazein parhta hai: Fajr, phir Zuhr, phir Asr, phir Maghrib, phir Isha, aur har namaz ka ek maloom waqt hai.

dialogue.ar: وَثالِثُها الزَّكاةُ، وَهِيَ جُزْءٌ مِنَ المالِ يَدْفَعُهُ المُسْلِمُ لِلفُقَراء.
dialogue.tr: wathālithuhā z-zakāh, wahiya juzʾun mina l-māli yadfaʿuhu l-muslimu lilfuqarāʾ.
dialogue.en: The third is zakah, a part of wealth that a Muslim pays to the poor.
dialogue.ur: Teesra zakat hai, jo maal ka ek hissa hai jo Musalman faqeeron ko deta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَرابِعُها الصِّيامُ، فَيَمْتَنِعُ المُسْلِمُ في رَمَضانَ عَنِ الطَّعامِ وَالشَّرابِ مِنَ الفَجْرِ إِلى غُروبِ الشَّمْس.
dialogue.tr: warābiʿuhā ṣ-ṣīm, fayamtaniʿu l-muslimu fī ramaḍāna ʿani ṭ-ṭaʿāmi wālshsharābi mina l-fajri ilā ghurūbi sh-shams.
dialogue.en: The fourth is fasting; in Ramadan a Muslim refrains from food and drink from dawn to sunset.
dialogue.ur: Chautha roza hai; Ramazan mein Musalman fajr se ghuroob-e-aftab tak khane peene se ruk jata hai.

dialogue.ar: وَآخِرُها الحَجُّ؛ أَيْ قَصْدُ مَكَّةَ لِأَداءِ المَناسِك، وَهُوَ واجِبٌ مَرَّةً في العُمُر.
dialogue.tr: waʾākhiruhā l-ḥajj; ay qaṣdu makkata liʾadāʾi l-manāsik, wahuwa wājibun marratan fī l-ʿumur.
dialogue.en: The fifth is Hajj, which is visiting the House of Allah in Makkah to perform the rites, and it is required once in a lifetime.
dialogue.ur: Paanchwan hajj hai, yaani Makkah mein Baitullah ki ziyarat manasik ada karne ke liye, aur yeh zindagi mein ek baar wajib hai.

q.en: How many pillars does Islam have?
Which pillar is performed five times a day?
q.ur: Kaun sa rukn din mein paanch martaba hota hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ رُكْنٍ يُؤَدّى خَمْسَ مَرّاتٍ في اليَوْمِ؟

q.en: Which pillar gives money to the poor?
q.ur: Kaun sa rukn ghareebon ko maal dena hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ رُكْنٍ فيهِ إِعْطاءُ المالِ لِلفُقَراءِ؟

title.en: The counted noun for numbers 3 to 10

intro.en: Numbers 3 to 10 go opposite to the gender of the counted noun. The counted noun is plural and in the genitive. Example: ثَلاثَةُ أَبْناءٍ (three sons, masculine) but ثَلاثُ بَناتٍ (three daughters, feminine).
intro.ur: 3 se 10 tak adaad, ma'dood ke mozakkar/moannas ke ulat aate hain. Ma'dood jama aur majroor hota hai. Misaal: ثَلاثَةُ أَبْناءٍ (teen bete, mozakkar) lekin ثَلاثُ بَناتٍ (teen betiyan, moannas).
intro.ar: الأَعْدادُ مِنْ ٣ إِلى ١٠ تُخالِفُ المَعْدودَ في التَّذْكيرِ وَالتَّأْنيثِ، وَالمَعْدودُ جَمْعٌ مَجْرورٌ. مِثالٌ: ثَلاثَةُ أَبْناءٍ (مُذَكَّرٌ) وَثَلاثُ بَناتٍ (مُؤَنَّثٌ).

q.en: Which is correct for three daughters?
q.ur: Teen betiyon ke liye kaun sa durust hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ صَحيحَةٌ لِلدَّلالَةِ عَلى ثَلاثِ بَناتٍ؟

q.en: Which is correct for four books (كُتُب, masculine)?
q.ur: Chaar kitabon (كُتُب, mozakkar) ke liye kaun sa durust hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ صَحيحَةٌ لِلدَّلالَةِ عَلى أَرْبَعَةِ كُتُبٍ (كُتُب مُذَكَّرٌ)؟

q.en: The counted noun after numbers 3-10 is ...
q.ar: المَعْدودُ بَعْدَ الأَعْدادِ مِنْ ٣ إِلى ١٠ يَكونُ...

q.en: How do you say «five rooms» (غُرَف, feminine)?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ صَحيحَةٌ لِلدَّلالَةِ عَلى خَمْسِ غُرَفٍ (غُرَف مُؤَنَّثٌ)؟

intro.en: In this lesson you practise writing. Turn the first dialogue into a story, write a short essay called 'Islam', then retell the second dialogue and summarise 'The Five Pillars'.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein tehreer ki mashq hai. Pehle mukalme ko kahani ki shakl mein likhein, phir 'Islam' par mazmoon likhein, doosre mukalme ko dohrayein aur 'Arkan-e-Islam' ka khulasa likhein.
intro.ar: في هذا الدَّرْسِ تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى الكِتابَةِ: حَوِّلِ الحِوارَ الأَوَّلَ إِلى قِصَّةٍ، وَاكْتُبْ مَوْضوعاً قَصيراً بِعُنْوانِ «الإِسْلام»، ثُمَّ أَعِدْ سَرْدَ الحِوارِ الثّاني وَلَخِّصْ «أَرْكانَ الإِسْلامِ الخَمْسَةَ».

dialogue.ar: أَرادَ يوناسُ أَنْ يَعْرِفَ أَشْياءَ عَنِ الإِسْلامِ، فَسَأَلَ زَميلَهُ إِبْراهيمَ، فَرَحَّبَ بِهِ.
dialogue.tr: arāda yūnāsu an yaʿrifa ashyāʾa ʿani l-islām, fasaʾala zamīlahu ibrāhīm, faraḥḥaba bih.
dialogue.en: Jonas wanted to know some things about Islam, so he asked his classmate Ibrahim, who welcomed him.
dialogue.ur: Yonas Islam ke bare mein kuch jaanna chahta tha, is liye us ne apne hum-jamaat Ibrahim se poocha, jis ne us ka khair-maqdam kiya.

dialogue.ar: رَأى هِنْري ماركوس يَخْرُجُ مِنَ المَسْجِدِ، فَسَأَلَ صَديقَهُ ريتشارْد، فَأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ ماركوس أَسْلَمَ.
dialogue.tr: raʾā hinrī mārkūs yakhruju mina l-masjid, fasaʾala ṣadīqahu rītshārd, faʾakhbarahu anna mārkūs aslam.
dialogue.en: Henry saw Marcus coming out of the mosque and asked his friend Richard, who told him that Marcus had become Muslim.
dialogue.ur: Henry ne Marcus ko masjid se nikalte dekha aur apne dost Richard se poocha, jis ne bataya ke Marcus Musalman ho gaya hai.

title.en: Calligraphy and spelling: nunation of the accusative

intro.en: First, practise the Ruq'ah script with a line of poetry. Then learn the rule: tanween on alif is written on the alif, except after a hamza on the line, or after ة. Example: عَزيزاً حَكيماً, but جُزْءاً and كَلِمَةً.
intro.ur: Pehle ruqah khat mein ek sher likhne ki mashq. Phir qaida: tanween-e-nasb alif par likha jata hai, magar jab us se pehle hamza alif ke upar ho ya aakhir mein ة ho. Misaal: عَزيزاً حَكيماً, lekin جُزْءاً aur كَلِمَةً.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ أَوَّلاً عَلى خَطِّ الرُّقْعَةِ بِبَيْتِ شِعْرٍ. ثُمَّ تَعَلَّمِ القاعِدَةَ: يُكْتَبُ تَنْوينُ النَّصْبِ عَلى الأَلِفِ، إِلّا بَعْدَ هَمْزَةٍ عَلى السَّطْرِ أَوْ بَعْدَ التّاءِ المَرْبوطَةِ. مِثالٌ: عَزيزاً حَكيماً، لكِنْ جُزْءاً وَكَلِمَةً.

dialogue.ar: لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ إِذا ما تَمَّ نُقْصانُ، فَلا يُغَرَّ بِطيبِ العَيْشِ إِنْسانُ.
dialogue.tr: li-kulli shayʾin idhā mā tamma nuqṣān, fa-lā yughharra biṭībi l-ʿayshi insān
dialogue.en: Everything, once complete, begins to decline; so let no one be fooled by the pleasantness of life.
dialogue.ur: Har cheez jab mukammal ho jaye to us mein kami aati hai; isliye koi insan zindagi ki khushgawari se dhoke mein na rahe.

q.en: Where is the tanween-nasb written in «عَزيزاً»?
q.ur: «عَزيزاً» mein tanween-e-nasb kahan likha jata hai?
q.ar: عَلى أَيِّ حَرْفٍ يُكْتَبُ تَنْوينُ النَّصْبِ في «عَزيزاً»؟

q.en: Which word has its tanween on the hamza, with no extra alif?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein tanween hamza par hai, alif ke baghair?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ يُكْتَبُ تَنْوينُها عَلى الهَمْزَةِ دونَ أَلِفٍ إِضافِيَّةٍ؟

q.en: How is the tanween written on «كَلِمَةً»?
q.ur: «كَلِمَةً» mein tanween kaise likha jata hai?

options: on the ta marbutah, no alif
